root_cause: Pipeline and discovery status were primarily file-backed under artifacts/ on ephemeral Railway disk. After redeploy the local JSON could be empty/missing while Home/health sometimes read the file before AppSetting restore. Partial AppSetting writes could also clobber last_successful_completion. Frontend could also paint empty Home if dashboard fetch failed while public health still updated the build badge.
fix: M3PipelineStore now treats Postgres AppSetting as authoritative (file is cache). Dashboard/health always reload_from_durable. Discovery _save_state preserves last_successful_completion. Home always refetches dashboard with credentials same-origin and always renders discovery status placeholder.
